title: ISAD 3000
shortdesc: A sample project for testing uploads: a course portal with lessons, quizzes and progress tracking.
fulldesc: ISAD 3000 is an example project used to check that uploaded projects appear in search, filters and the project count. It covers lesson delivery, student progress and lecturer reporting.

title: Campus Energy Dashboard
shortdesc: Live energy usage from campus buildings shown on an interactive dashboard.
fulldesc: Sensors report electricity and water use every minute. The dashboard highlights waste, compares buildings and sends alerts when usage spikes.

title: Library Seat Booking App
shortdesc: Students reserve study seats and get reminders before bookings expire.
fulldesc: A mobile-friendly app where students pick a floor and seat, check in with a QR code, and release seats early so others can use them.
